title: Cowboy Songs and Other Frontier Ballads
edition: New York: The Macmillan Company, February 1929 printing. Copyright notice 1910, 1916 belongs to earlier publication history; it is not the supplied printing date.

deduplication: Deferred to common integration across these ten collections and the existing corpus; eligibility counts are not import counts.
notes: The printed contents points The U. S. A. Recruit to page247, but the title and text begin at page249. Both index_anchor and actual source_locator are recorded.

California Joe is excluded as an extended framed narrative poem. Ordinary song ballads, including the fourteen short-lined stanzas of Her White Bosom Bare, remain intact; no numeric length ceiling is imposed.
Single-line choruses, abbreviated refrains printed as 'etc.', and the supplied song titled A Fragment are preserved without expansion or invented reconstruction.
Compiler John A. Lomax is not credited as author of anonymous songs. Named and qualified author attributions are taken from explicit headings/footnotes.

Printed chorus/refrain headings are structural [CHORUS]/[REFRAIN] markers. Omission marks and performance instructions use # APPARATUS comments; they remain auditable but are excluded from sung verse line counts. Spoken labels are apparatus; the source speech words remain intact.
